Moss: | }} '''Moss''' is a grass-like plant that grows on Stone Blocks. It comes in 11 different variants. Mossy stone requires one more hit to break than clean stone. Moss will be destroyed if the Stone Block it is on converts to Ebonstone, Crimstone, or Pearlstone. Moss sprouts fuzz that can be cut like wild grass plants. Using a Paint Scraper or Spectre Paint Scraper to harvest moss fuzz has a chance of dropping moss as a plantable item. Collected moss can be placed on Stone Blocks and Gray Bricks

The cycling colors of Rainbow Bricks, Rainbow Brick Walls, Helium Moss, Helium Moss Brick, Helium Moss Brick Walls, Rainbow Torches, the Disco Ball, and Rainbow Hair Dye are synchronized with each other. Paintings: '''Paintings''' are decorative furniture items that can be placed on background walls. Each one is a framed image that depicts a particular scene, usually ''Terraria''-related. Their tooltips generally contain a person's name, intended to credit each painting's artist; although the names appear to be fictional, most of them correspond to known ''Terraria'' developers, artists, testing staff, and community members ''(see Trivia below)''.
